description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This vital leadership role supports the Director of Nursing in overseeing clinical operations, ensuring the highest standards of patient care, and fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff. If you are a compassionate leader with a commitment to excellence, we encourage you to apply.

As an ADON, you will play a crucial role in maintaining regulatory compliance, developing care plans, and mentoring nursing staff. This position offers a competitive annual salary range of $60,000 - $75,000, reflecting your expertise and contributions to our team. Join a facility that values quality care and professional growth.
requirements: Previous experience in a skilled nursing facility or long-term care setting
Demonstrated leadership and supervisory experience in nursing
Strong clinical assessment and critical thinking skills
Ability to ensure compliance with all state and federal regulations
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $60,000 - $75,000, based on experience and qualifications.

description: We are seeking dedicated and compassionate Certified Nursing Assistants (CNAs) to join the team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Vernon, AL. This full-time position offers the opportunity to provide essential direct patient care during the evening (PM) shift, contributing significantly to the well-being and daily lives of residents.As a CNA, you will play a vital role in assisting residents with activities of daily living, ensuring their comfort, dignity, and safety. This includes personal care, mobility assistance, and maintaining a clean and supportive environment. We are looking for individuals who are committed to delivering high-quality, patient-centered care and thrive in a collaborative setting.
requirements: Active Certified Nursing Assistant (CNA) certification in Alabama
Ability to work full-time PM shifts
Commitment to providing compassionate and respectful care
